component.summary: Write and organize private local notes
निजी स्थानीय नोट लिखें और व्यवस्थित करें

description.p: Notes keeps writing, folders, tags, pinned items, and search together in a focused native workspace.
Its local-first design keeps the on-disk repository authoritative and does not imply a cloud account.
